title: Retry stale jobs by merging the kept candidate onto the tip
summary: Retry job 20261106-062207-cbcc: redo the stale-job retry (accept stale in `athena retry`, merge the kept candidate onto the tip, re-verify and land with no producer on a clean merge, producer from the candidate on conflict), fixing its findings: append the new decision at the true end of docs/decisions.md after D156, and make the stale reader brief accurate when the seed falls back to the base.

defaults_applied.how: Behavior criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass with new tests.
Behavior verified by running the named tests.
Fixes the log-placement cause by appending at end, and the brief/fallback mismatch.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
Criteria check landing and producer-call counts, not wiring.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Retry of job 20261106-062207-cbcc (rejected, 1 major, 1 minor, 1 nit): the major finding (D157 inserted in the middle of D156's last bullet) is fixed by appending the new decision at true end of file; the minor finding (reader brief claims merge even when stale_seed falls back to base) is fixed by making the brief wording accurate and testing it; the nit (stale shared target dir artifact) is an environment artifact and does not apply to the code. The rest of that candidate's approach is kept, redone from the base because earlier changes were discarded.

Goal: `athena retry` accepts a stale job, merges its candidate onto the tip, re-verifies and lands without a producer on clean merge, producer retry from the candidate on conflict. Audience: users running parallel jobs and the verifier.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (earlier_attempt_with at ~line 1346, the retry entry that currently refuses stale jobs), and the earlier attempt's touched paths crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs (stale_seed), run/close.rs, land.rs (plan(), Plan::Stale), crates/athena-git/src/lib.rs (merge_tree_conflicts), crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs (reader_brief). No new record or data file under crates/ is added, so check_record_file/AnyRecord are not affected. The property is measured directly by tests that count recorded producer calls and compare the verified fingerprint to the landed one. Not every file was read in full by me.
This change adds no new refusal rule; it relaxes one (stale retry is newly accepted), so no refusal-rate criterion applies.
docs/decisions.md was seen to end with D156 as latest heading (line 4269); the new decision is numbered next (D157) and placed after D156's final line.

acceptance_criteria.text: Run `cargo test`: a test shows `athena retry` on a stale job returns a proposal instead of an error.
Run `cargo test`: a test where the kept candidate merges cleanly onto a moved tip shows checks, replay and verification run on the merged tree, the job lands, and zero producer calls are recorded.
Run `cargo test`: a test where the candidate conflicts with the moved tip shows a producer retry seeded from the kept candidate, and nothing lands without a new verification.
Run `cargo test`: a test shows the landed fingerprint equals the one verified on the merged tree; existing land.rs Plan::Stale refusal tests still pass.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`: all pass, including the_decision_log_is_well_formed_and_only_appended_to.

Run `cargo test`: a reader_brief test covers the stale-retry wording for both the merge case and the fallback to the base (candidate missing, verification mismatch, violations, or merge-tree error), so the brief no longer says the candidate will be merged when stale_seed returns None; the producer's stale_seed fallback is tested.

docs/decisions.md: the new decision (reversing D10's left-out alternative (d), citing D10 by id, reason: stale landings now recur with parallel jobs) is appended as the LAST entry after the end of D156 (the final bullet of D156, including its 'Not measured: how many future changes will touch the two D08 paths...' lines, stays intact and contiguous). `git diff -U0 -- docs/decisions.md` shows a single added hunk at end of file and no changed or removed line.
CHANGELOG.md states only what the diff does; README.md text saying stale jobs are refused is corrected; the retry help text in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs is updated.
Only the listed files change; no secrets or personal data are committed.

out_of_scope: Automatic (drain-triggered) re-verification of stale jobs without an explicit athena retry
Changing the staleness rules in land.rs plan() (what makes a job stale)
Retrying other non-retryable states (landed, dropped, abandoned)
Editing or annotating any existing line of docs/decisions.md or docs/decision-links.toml
Prompt files and governance configuration (athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows)
departures: Larger multi-crate change than the typical job, so cost and time are raised; the earlier attempt had only one major finding, a docs placement, so pass probability is slightly higher.
hard_reason: Changes the run pipeline and landing path: how a stale job is retried, re-verified and landed.
